data.narrative:
Kvertus is a Defense & Security growth-stage company founded by Yaroslav Filimonov and Andrii Znaichenko, having raised approximately $130M to date. The sector includes a peer universe of 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms, with notable comparable companies including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Stage-progression methodology was the applicable triangulation approach. Using the $130M total capital raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical of growth-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $156M. Peer-median comparison was not applicable due to insufficient narrow-set matches within Defense & Security; while 23 same-sector peers exist, filtering by stage, adjacency, and valuation tier produced fewer than three datapoints necessary for reliable median derivation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $133M to $179M, centered at $156M. This single-method result carries meaningful uncertainty. The range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression midpoint. Key uncertainties include the absence of transaction multiples from same-stage Defense & Security comparables and reliance on capital raised as a proxy absent disclosed revenue or EBITDA. Further validation would require either proprietary data on recent peer fundraising rounds at this stage or disclosed financial metrics for the target company.
